bill.title: Ralph David Abernathy, Sr., National Historic Site Act
bill.latestActionText: Placed on Senate Legislative Calendar under General Orders. Calendar No. 482.

classification.plainSummary: This bill would establish the Ralph David Abernathy, Sr., National Historic Site in Georgia. The site would be managed by the National Park Service to preserve and interpret the home and legacy of civil rights leader Ralph David Abernathy. The bill authorizes the Secretary of the Interior to acquire property, enter into cooperative agreements, and take other actions necessary to establish and operate the historic site.

plain.whatItDoes: No one has written a summary of this bill yet. All we have is its title, and a title is not a description of a law. To find out what it does, you have to open the bill itself.

plain.everydayEffect: Nothing has changed yet. The title alone does not say what would change for you, and this tool will not guess. Most bills never become law.
